title: Dials file — constitution.yaml (kernel CONVENTIONS.md section 6)

root_policy.description: Repository-relative path of the root policy (section 3). Absent: no territory is claimed and the constitution is silent.

territory_dialect.description: Pattern dialect of every territory in this file. A reader that does not support the declared dialect reports a configuration failure, never a silent pass.

additionalProperties.description: A namespace. A policy's when a document with this id lies in the root policy's territory; otherwise a module's, keyed by its plugin name, whose keys are that module's own.

territory.description: Path patterns this policy claims, in the file's dialect. Meaningful only in a policy's namespace; elsewhere it claims nothing.

$comment: Every reader validates the keys it reads against these rules at each read; a malformed file is a configuration failure with its own exit code, never a silent pass. The file may be absent: every module ships defaults.
